item.title: Cursive writing requirements would change if proposed legislation passes
item.description: Lakewood Ranch's Mark Eubanks, a sixth grader at Dan R. Nolan Middle, has memorized how to write his signature in cursive. He uses it a good amount now that he is in middle school.But his signature is the only thing he is confident in writing in cursive. item.title: Bulk garbage pickups likely to return for Manatee County residents
item.description: Within a 15-minute presentation about Manatee County’s new garbage collection system, Director of Utilities Patrick Shea used one word that sums up the public’s response to the changes — consternation. Whether it’s once a week pickup, the size of the cans, or the elimination of bulk pickup, residents from every area of the county have come forward with complaints.
